thesis: GMAB has roughly doubled in six months on a single late-October gap, and it is now making lower highs and lower lows while sitting on its 10-day low. The market is in a violent risk-off regime (QQQ below both averages, VIX at the 99th percentile), and a high-beta, extended name is the kind that gets sold when funds raise cash. The proposed stop is only about 0.7 ATR from entry, so noise alone can stop it out. The real support is the gap-fill zone at 44-45, far below the stop. Valuation is stretched on earnings (trailing PE 43, forward PE 32) with earnings growth negative and debt above cash.
